text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + timeout spike on /v1/generate in us-west1. 12% 5xxs over last 5m, tail latency rising. Paging @ryan_oncall :rotating_light: -- see metrics dashboard https://redwood.internal/ops/alerts/1778881230
Alex P: acked, I'm on it. grabbing logs and tracing.
Ryan O (oncall): oncall here, thanks. can someone post the current error sample? are these 502/504/500? any customer reports yet?
Meera K: seeing mostly 504 timeouts and gateway 502 when requests hit the batcher. spike started ~10:03 UTC. request rate for embeddings doubled due to a partner job.
Jonah L: opening scheduler metrics: queue depth for embed-batcher peaked at 9k, batching window backlog grew -> head-of-line blocking. KV cache prefetch also spiked.
Sara T: customer impact: a few enterprise customers reported degraded responses in us-west1; no total outage but high error surface. Support is triaging tickets.
Devon R: hypothesis: sudden embed job caused long-running requests to starve out short ones in the same priority queue. scheduler didn't preempt.
Alex P: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) enable priority preemption for short ops 2) temporarily route new /v1/generate traffic to us-east1 fallback 3) shrink max_batch_latency for embed-batcher to 25ms
Ryan O (oncall): let's try 2) fallback route first. Meera, can you flip routing policy for low-latency tier to prefer us-east1? add 10% sample to confirm.
Meera K: routing change in progress. command:
```
redwoodctl route modify --service v1-generate --region-preference us-east1 --sample 10
```
Meera K: sample routed. early telemetry: error rate for routed traffic ~1.2% in us-east1. us-west1 still noisy.
Jonah L: applying local mitigation on scheduler: reducing max_batch_latency and enabling eviction for longest-in-queue. patch:
```
--- scheduler.conf
- max_batch_latency_ms: 100
+ max_batch_latency_ms: 25
+ enable_priority_preempt: true
+ eviction_policy: longest_first
```
Jonah L: patch rolled to us-west1 batcher pool.
Sara T: support update: customers on routed sample see better behavior. notifying impacted customers with ETA ~20m.
Devon R: watching KV cache growth: we also see kvcache.prefetch hitting CPU hot paths. evicting cold prefixes now.
Alex P: good. will keep an eye on latency and 5xx rate. if we don't see improvement in 10m, escalate to scale-up dedicated pool.
incidents-bot: NOTE: routing change + scheduler patch applied. monitoring window started.
Meera K: 5m check: us-west1 5xx down from 12% -> 3.6%. tail latency dropping from 3.8s -> 1.4s. queue depth trending down.
Ryan O (oncall): nice work. keep patches live for 30m, then revert routing sample gradually. create follow-up postmortem ticket.
Alex P: opened PM ticket: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-1778881230. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.
Jonah L: root cause provisional: unthrottled partner embed job + non-preemptive batching queue -> head-of-line starvation + KV prefetch CPU spike. Long-running embed requests blocked new short gen requests.
Sara T: I'll coordinate customer comms and list affected tenants in the PM doc.
Devon R: next actions: 1) add short-term throttles on partner jobs 2) add preemption and priority isolation for small-gen vs long-embed 3) add alert for queue depth + per-priority latency
Ryan O (oncall): agreed. I'll keep channel open for 60m then hand back to oncall rotation. Thanks team.
Alex P: final check 20m later: us-west1 5xx ~0.9%, latency normalized. closing live mitigation but keeping changes under observation. will include config diffs in postmortem.
incidents-bot: Incident resolved: paging cleared. Please file retrospective and action items.
